title.en: Follow the gains and the losses

intro.en: Explore 2,838 published NAV observations. Select a month to inspect its path, or move through the full history with the shared cursor.
intro.zh: 探索2838个已发布净值观测。选择月份查看对应路径，也可以用联动游标逐点查看完整历史。

timeline.en: NAV and drawdown share one date cursor
timeline.zh: 净值与回撤共用日期游标

drawdown.zh: 相对完整历史峰值的回撤

help.en: Use the arrow keys on the chart or the observation slider. Observations are equally spaced, so gaps in calendar time are compressed. Drawdown retains peaks before the selected range.
help.zh: 在图中使用方向键，或拖动观测滑块。观测点等距排列，日历时间中的空缺会被压缩。回撤保留所选区间之前的历史峰值。

calendarHelp.en: Each cell compares its final observation with the preceding month’s final observation. * marks an endpoint month with partial source coverage. The first month starts at the first available NAV. Blank cells have no observations.
calendarHelp.zh: 每格比较本月末次观测与上月末次观测。星号标记数据边界处未覆盖完整月份的月份。首月以首个可用净值为起点。空格表示没有观测。

distribution.en: Holding periods change the range of outcomes
distribution.zh: 持有期限改变收益分布

distributionHelp.en: All overlapping windows use the full frozen series. Their dependence prevents interpreting loss frequency as an independent-trial probability. Returns exclude execution costs.
distributionHelp.zh: 全部重叠窗口均取自完整冻结序列。窗口之间存在依赖关系，亏损频率不能解读为独立试验概率。收益未计入执行成本。

exact.zh: 精确观测与直方图计数

reduced.en: Playback is disabled while reduced motion is preferred. The slider remains available.
reduced.zh: 减少动态效果偏好开启时停止播放，仍可使用滑块。

scope.en: Frozen NAV series from 2015-01-05 to 2026-09-04. This historical path does not establish executable returns.
scope.zh: 冻结净值序列覆盖2015年1月5日至2026年9月4日。该历史路径不代表可实现收益。
